decisions.reason: The superfood drink mix is peripheral to the firm's waste and energy technology direction, and it has not appeared on the website since 2019, so the option has shown no value and its resources are better spent on core ventures.
The modular plant extensions build directly on the established waste-to-energy offer and cost little to keep available, so the option is worth holding even though their recent visibility is unclear.

The waste oil plant is a flagship built on core capabilities, and its long sales cycles mean its value is still resolving, so continued commitment is justified despite the lack of recent website evidence.
